pf.license.need: from the state form: coaching group fitness classes usually needs no state license; some states register health clubs or gyms that sell memberships, and may ask for a bond for months paid ahead; massage needs a license where the state's rules require it
pf.license.who: the business, for any health club registration or bond; each massage therapist, for their own license
pf.license.ask: any health club registration number; each massage therapist's license number in their invite reply (or the owner sends it)
pf.license.check: none: Rosie never looks up, checks or confirms a license, insurance or registration (D96); anything shown is as given by the business, not checked by Rosie
pf.license.coachCertificate: a switch from the state's form: where the state requires a certificate for a fitness coach, it's asked and checked like a license; otherwise a coach's certificate and CPR card are the business's word, shown as the gym's word, never as a license
pf.license.blocks: nothing waits on a license (D96): the business and each person go live once set up and the owner says yes; a job the owner says needs a license they don't have isn't booked
pf.license.renewals: optional reminders the owner sets; a license the owner says has lapsed pauses that person's new bookings for that work (the owner's word, never a check)
pf.license.insurance: liability insurance where the state's form asks; an office or building may ask for proof before an on-site class
pf.license.background: background checks for coaches of teen classes, where the state's rules require them

pf.services.examples: the example gym's own prices (Lee's Gym and Lee Fitness Crew), not a standard

pf.services.intro: the intro offer: once per person, checked by the mobile number; a first-timer sees it on the secure page, never in a text
pf.services.packs: class packs, memberships and the intro offer are sold on the secure page while booking (and at the desk), never offered in a booking text; a booking then uses one class, or the membership covers it
pf.services.capacity: seats per class, set by the room: 20 bikes, 24 HIIT spots, 16 boxing bags; each seat is one person with their own check-in code; the gym floor has no cap; away from the gym, the host's group size
pf.services.waitlist: a full class keeps a waitlist in order; a freed seat is offered by text inside text hours, to one person at a time, for 30 minutes; the waitlist closes 2 hours before class; seats not claimed at the start go to people waiting at the desk, in waitlist order
pf.services.minimum: a class runs only with its minimum (the owner's setting, like 4 people), checked a set time before (like 24 hours); Sam decides, and no answer means it runs
pf.services.skills: indoor cycling, HIIT, boxing, strength, teen classes, chair fitness; teen classes only with coaches cleared for them; massage only by licensed massage therapists
pf.services.gear: cycling shoes, gloves, wraps and towels lent free, held per booking; nothing needs a damage hold
pf.services.online: yes: a live video class counts as at the gym; the code is read out at the start
pf.services.nobodyHome: never: the group must be there

the class, or a day pass, and which day

securePage: 18 or older (13 to 17 with a parent's or guardian's OK, where the gym and the state's rules allow it)

pf.questions.whoMayBook: an adult; a parent or guardian for anyone 13 to 17, who signs the waiver; under 13 not booked. Away from the gym: the host books, and each person attending signs their own waiver

stop.words: someone unwell right now: chest pain, fainting, trouble breathing, a bad fall

goOn.words: a heart condition, a recent surgery or injury, pregnancy, or a doctor's limit
goOn.what: the booking goes on; the answer stays on the secure page, and the coach reads it before class; Rosie gives no health advice

goOn.words: asks if a class is safe for them
goOn.what: no advice from Rosie; the question goes to the gym privately, and the person can still cancel in the free time

pf.safety.coachStops: a coach can stop anyone who looks unwell, at any time, and follows the gym's first-aid steps; 911 if it's serious; the class goes on for the rest
pf.safety.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency → call 911, and no booking

steps.name: Waiver
steps.when: before the first visit, signed on the secure page while booking
steps.who: every new person; a parent or guardian signs for anyone 13 to 17; away from the gym, each person attending signs their own
steps.goodFor: 1 year (the example gym's setting), or until the gym changes it
steps.result: signed: the booking goes on; not signed in 10 minutes: nothing is booked

steps.name: Health questions
steps.when: on the secure page, before the first visit and once a year
steps.result: the booking goes on either way; any yes is read by the coach before class, on the secure page

steps.name: Photo ID
steps.when: at the desk on the first visit
steps.result: the desk checks the name and age against the waiver; Rosie stores only 'ID seen' and by whom, never a copy

pf.first_steps.prep: for the reminder: come 10 minutes early (15 for a first ride, for the bike set-up); bring a photo ID on the first visit, and water; shoes, gloves and towels to borrow; away from the gym, a clear space about 20 by 20 feet for 12 people

pf.visit.checkIn: at the gym: each person booked gives their own check-in code at the front desk, or the desk ticks names on the class roster; away from the gym: the host's code at the door or the meeting spot; a live video class: read out at the start
pf.visit.photoId: the first visit needs a photo ID that matches the name and age on the waiver; no ID: no entry today, and the person can move to another day or get a refund (Sam's choice, by default no fee)
pf.visit.lateEntry: a class lets people in until 5 minutes after the start (the gym's rule, shown before booking); after that, an unclaimed seat may go to someone waiting at the desk, and a day pass still covers the gym floor
pf.visit.changes: an add-on (a body scan) is priced and OK'd first; a coach change is texted to everyone booked, with a free cancel
pf.visit.done: the check-in code or the roster tick; away from the gym, the code at the start or DONE from the coach
pf.visit.leftEarly: a class that has started counts as given (the gym's rule, shown before booking); Sam can refund part of it on the portal

pf.money.before: a day pass, the group ride party, packs, the intro offer and a membership's first month: paid in full when booking; a drop-in class or a private class for a group: a card saved for the $20 fee, paid at the front desk; away from the gym: a card saved for the $89 fee and charged at DONE (office and park bootcamps, a company fitness day), nothing taken for a company that pays by bill, or an office strength class paid in full
pf.money.packs: a class from a pack or a membership takes nothing at booking; a card is saved for the gym's fee; a late cancel or a no-show can use up the class instead of the fee (the owner's setting), only with the owner's yes
pf.money.membership: repeat charges need their own yes to the terms: the price, the charge date, and how to pause or end by text; where the state's rules set a written contract, a cancel period, a renewal notice or a limit on months paid ahead, the state's form sets it
pf.money.caps: deposit cap and how far ahead money may be taken: from the state form
pf.money.cancel: free to cancel until 24 hours before (the owner's setting); a longer right to cancel from the state form wins
pf.money.fees: late cancel or no-show: $20 at the gym ($40 for the group ride party), $89 away; the owner confirms each fee, never more than the class price; no answer, no fee
pf.money.refunds: a full refund whenever the gym cancels or changes a class (a sub coach, too few people, a room out)
pf.money.tips: off for classes; a tip line for on-site classes only if the owner turns it on
pf.money.tax: a tax line where the state's rules tax memberships, passes or goods
pf.money.fee2: Rosfield's $2 applies; a class seat counts toward whoever checks it in

pf.messages.never: health answers, injuries, pregnancy and incident notes never go in a text or through the AI, and texts to the owner or staff carry none either: only a link to the secure page
pf.messages.minors: a teen's booking texts go to the parent or guardian
pf.messages.waitlist: waitlist offers go out inside text hours only; a seat that opens later is offered at 9am

pf.staff.licenses: no person license for coaching group fitness unless the state's form names one; massage therapists hold their own license per state
pf.staff.certificate: a coach's certificate and CPR card: a switch from the state's form (checked where required, otherwise the gym's word)
pf.staff.skills: indoor cycling, HIIT, boxing, strength, teen classes, chair fitness; only coaches cleared for teen classes coach them
pf.staff.supervision: coaches in training assist only with a lead coach in the room
pf.staff.oks: Sam OKs a class with too few people, every fee, same-day on-site classes, a first-timer's same-day boxing class (for the safety talk), and any quote over $500 (Pat too, for Lee Fitness Crew)
pf.staff.standIn: a sub who coaches that class takes the whole class; everyone booked is told and can cancel with no fee
pf.staff.away: only coaches Sam sets for on-site work go to offices, parks and buildings

pf.rules.cancelRight: a longer right to cancel a fitness booking or membership where the state's rules give one (a switch from the state form)
pf.rules.contracts: a written membership contract, what it must show, and any bond or account kept apart for months paid ahead, where the state's rules require it
pf.rules.renewals: memberships that renew: what must be shown, the renewal notice and how to cancel, where the state's rules require it
pf.rules.prepay: how far ahead a pass, a pack or a membership may be paid, where the state's rules limit it
pf.rules.waiver: what a waiver may say, where the state's rules limit it; the state form sets the words (a risk notice where a release isn't allowed)
pf.rules.minors: whether teens may be booked and at what age, with a guardian's OK (a switch from the gym and the state's form)
pf.rules.parks: a city's permit for a group class in a park, where it asks for one
pf.rules.showFacts: posted prices, cancel terms and membership terms where the state's rules require them
pf.rules.records: waivers, health answers and incident notes kept with the person's record: 7 years, or longer where the state asks

pf.edges.full: a full class: the waitlist, in order; a freed seat is offered by text for 30 minutes
pf.edges.unclaimed: seats not claimed at the start go to people waiting at the desk, in waitlist order
pf.edges.tooFew: too few people at the cutoff: Sam decides to run or cancel; a cancel refunds everyone in full (a class from a pack goes back), and no answer means the class runs
pf.edges.sub: a coach out: a sub who coaches that class; everyone booked is told and may cancel with no fee
pf.edges.room: a room or bikes out: the class moves or changes, with a free cancel
pf.edges.late: late: in until 5 minutes after the start; then the seat may go to someone waiting, and a day pass still covers the gym floor
pf.edges.noId: no photo ID on the first visit: no entry today; a free move or a refund, Sam's choice
pf.edges.unwell: someone looks unwell in class: the coach stops them, follows the gym's first-aid steps, and calls 911 if it's serious; Sam is told; notes on the secure page
pf.edges.friend: booking a friend too: each person gets their own seat, their own code and their own waiver
pf.edges.weather: a park bootcamp in bad weather: new times or a free cancel
pf.edges.other: all other edge cases the generic way
pf.edges.urgent: no class is sent now and nobody is on call: a same-day on-site class gets the soonest time, with the owner's OK
